title: Runtime envelopes and deadlines
responsibility: Validates runtime response envelopes and applies a timeout to both yielded and thread-blocking calls.

inputs.name: runtimeResponse.value
inputs.description: Any value to validate; runtimeResponseText passes it the result of JSON.parse. Only a non-null object can pass: it is returned unchanged when ok is exactly true and it has an output property (any value), or when ok is exactly false and error has string code and message properties; any other value becomes an invalid-response failure.

error.message: runtime returned text that is not JSON

inputs.name: runtimeResponseText.text
inputs.description: The text a byte transport returned, parsed with JSON.parse before envelope validation. Text that JSON.parse rejects yields an invalid-response failure with the message 'runtime returned text that is not JSON', and parsed JSON that is not a valid envelope yields an invalid-response failure with the message 'runtime returned a value that is not a response envelope'.
examples: runtime exited with code 137 before writing a reply

inputs.name: runtimeDeadline.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Milliseconds allowed for the call, measured from deadline creation. It is passed to setTimeout, and settle replaces a result with a timeout failure when more than timeoutMs has elapsed since creation; the value is not validated.

outputs.name: runtimeResponse
outputs.description: The input object itself, not a copy, when it is a valid envelope; otherwise an invalid-response failure with the message 'runtime returned a value that is not a response envelope'. A valid envelope has ok exactly true with an output property, or ok exactly false with string error.code and error.message.

error.message: runtime returned a value that is not a response envelope

outputs.name: runtimeResponseText
outputs.description: A valid envelope is the object JSON.parse produced, returned unchanged. Text that JSON.parse rejects yields an invalid-response failure with the message 'runtime returned text that is not JSON', and parsed JSON that is not a valid envelope yields an invalid-response failure with the message 'runtime returned a value that is not a response envelope'.

error.message: runtime returned text that is not JSON

outputs.name: runtimeDeadline
outputs.description: An object with an expired promise, which resolves with runtimeTimeout(timeoutMs) once the timer fires, and a settle(response) method that clears the timer and returns response unless more than timeoutMs has elapsed since creation, in which case it returns runtimeTimeout(timeoutMs). A timer cannot fire while the thread is blocked, so settle is what catches a result that blocking work produced after the limit.
